# Adam and Eve in the Garden (Genesis 2:8)

## Emotional Focus
Wondering at the beautiful world God made just for us.

## Key KJV
“And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.” (Genesis 2:8)

## Gentle Retelling
God made a beautiful garden and placed Adam and Eve there. He walked with them in the cool of the day and gave them everything good to enjoy. The world was full of wonder and they were safe and loved.

## Coloring Prompt
Adam and Eve walking happily together in a lush garden with flowers, trees, and gentle animals all around; soft golden light.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God made this beautiful world and He made you too. You can say thank You to Him anytime.”
